title: Cohomology over an open commutes with a derived inverse limit
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and let $(K_n)$ be an inverse system in the derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-derived-limit]. For every open subset $U\subseteq X$, derived sections $R\Gamma(U,-)$ commute with the derived inverse limit. For every integer $m$ there is a natural short exact sequence $$0\to R^1\varprojlim_n H^{m-1}(U,K_n)\to H^m(U,R\varprojlim_n K_n)\to\varprojlim_n H^m(U,K_n)\to0,$$ where the cohomology groups are the derived-functor cohomology of $U$ [pqf-def-cohomology].
